independent_review.scope: V2.1.3 USB-only bootloader command, uploader and USB session lifecycle
independent_review.method: Read-only source review against the V2.1.2 source snapshot and pinned STM32 core/HAL; no device access or shared builds

initial_findings.title: Immediate COM close can discard the SCPI boot command
initial_findings.resolution: Keep the verified COM handle open throughout DFU detection; close in finally on success or error. Check the complete write count.
initial_findings.regression: Full mocked update lifecycle asserts the handle stays open through missing and successful DFU probes

initial_findings.title: Pending OUT completion in PMA can cross a DTR session boundary
initial_findings.resolution: Abort OUT, clear pending RX completion before opening, discard software RX and re-arm a full packet; retain endpoint data toggles.
initial_findings.regression: Actual backend callback model covers old PMA completion followed by open; hardware test exercises 100 immediate closed-write/open cycles

independent_review.final_review: Both original findings are resolved in the inspected source. No remaining concrete blocking issue found in this targeted review.
